json_schema.title: grains.get
json_schema.description: Attempt to retrieve the named value from grains, if the named value is not available return the passed default. The default return is an empty string

default.ui:title: Default value
default.ui:description: Value to return when the grain is missing

delimiter.ui:title: Delimiter
delimiter.ui:description: Specify an alternate delimiter to use when traversing a nested dict. This is useful for when the desired key contains a colon

ordered.ui:title: Ordered
ordered.ui:description: Outputs an ordered dict if applicable (default: True)
